# TechTalk.tech

> Independent tech magazine covering AI tools, digital productivity, web development, and creative software. Published in 7 languages.

TechTalk is an independent technology magazine that reviews and analyzes software tools across several categories:

## Categories

- **AI & Machine Learning**: Reviews of AI-powered tools for video dubbing, voice cloning, content generation
- **Tools & Productivity**: File converters, online utilities, workflow automation
- **Web Development**: Frameworks, hosting, development tools and practices
- **Creative Software**: AI interior design, image editing, creative applications

## Tools We Review

- [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io): AI video dubbing and voice cloning platform for YouTube creators
- [FileTools](https://filetools.eu): Free online file conversion (PDF, images, documents)
- [RoomFlip](https://roomflip.io): AI-powered interior design tool for room visualization
- [KupSledujici](https://kupsledujici.cz): Social media growth and marketing platform

## Languages

Articles are published in English, Czech (Čeština), German (Deutsch), French (Français), Spanish (Español), Polish (Polski), and Chinese (中文).

## Content

All articles are original, independent reviews. No sponsored content, no affiliate pressure. We test the tools we write about.
